description: This file defines the LogarithmicBestFit class, which extends the BestFit class and provides methods for logarithmic regression analysis, including calculating the best-fit line equation, and transforming data values for regression.

classes.name: LogarithmicBestFit
classes.description: A class that performs logarithmic regression to find a best-fit curve of logarithmic form and provides methods to evaluate and generate the regression equation.

methods.name: getValueOfYForX
methods.description: Calculates and returns the logarithmic regression's Y value for a given X value.

methods.name: getValueOfXForY
methods.description: Calculates and returns the X value corresponding to a given Y value in the logarithmic regression.

methods.name: getEquation
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the regression equation.

methods.name: logarithmicRegression
methods.description: Performs the logarithmic regression analysis on given data sets of Y and X values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the logarithmic regression with provided Y and X data.
